mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, related_type, related_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, sender.username AS sender_username, sender.real_name AS sender_real_name, sender.avatar AS sender_avatar, m.receiver_id, receiver.username AS receiver_username, receiver.real_name AS receiver_real_name, receiver.avatar AS receiver_avatar, m.content, m.related_type, m.related_id, m.is_read, m.create_time FROM message m LEFT JOIN user sender ON m.sender_id = sender.user_id LEFT JOIN user receiver ON m.receiver_id = receiver.user_id WHERE (m.sender_id = #{userId1} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.sender_id = #{userId2} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId1}) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, sender.username AS sender_username, sender.real_name AS sender_real_name, sender.avatar AS sender_avatar, m.receiver_id, receiver.username AS receiver_username, receiver.real_name AS receiver_real_name, receiver.avatar AS receiver_avatar, m.content, m.related_type, m.related_id, m.is_read, m.create_time FROM message m LEFT JOIN user sender ON m.sender_id = sender.user_id LEFT JOIN user receiver ON m.receiver_id = receiver.user_id WHERE ( (m.sender_id = #{userId1} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (m.sender_id = #{userId2} AND m.receiver_id = #{userId1}) ) AND m.id > #{sinceId} ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT conv.target_user_id AS user_id, u.username, u.real_name, u.avatar, latest.content AS last_message, latest.create_time AS last_message_time, IFNULL(unread.cnt, 0) AS unread_count, IFNULL(cs.is_pinned, 0) AS is_pinned FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS target_user_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM message WHERE sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId} GROUP BY target_user_id ) conv INNER JOIN message latest ON latest.id = conv.max_id INNER JOIN user u ON u.user_id = conv.target_user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sender_id AS from_user_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 GROUP BY sender_id ) unread ON unread.from_user_id = conv.target_user_id LEFT JOIN conversation_settings cs ON cs.user_id = #{userId} AND cs.other_user_id = conv.target_user_id WHERE IFNULL(cs.is_deleted, 0) = 0 ORDER BY IFNULL(cs.is_pinned, 0) DESC, latest.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId1} AND receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND receiver_id = #{userId1})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId1} AND receiver_id = #{userId2}) OR (sender_id = #{userId2} AND receiver_id = #{userId1})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (type, title, content, sender_id, receiver_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{senderId}, NULL, 0, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(reply_minutes) FROM ( SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF( MINUTE, m1.create_time, ( SELECT MIN(m2.create_time) FROM message m2 WHERE m2.sender_id = #{userId} AND m2.receiver_id = m1.sender_id AND m2.create_time > m1.create_time ) ) AS reply_minutes FROM message m1 WHERE m1.receiver_id = #{userId} ) t WHERE reply_minutes IS NOT NULL
